artisan_female_en.ref_text: Step into our cozy craft studio, friend... Let's light a warm lantern and build something wonderful.
artisan_female_en.instruct: A cheerful, capable young female artisan and coach in her late twenties. Warm mezzo-soprano voice, lively yet gentle smile, crisp articulation and unhurried child-friendly rhythm.

artisan_female_zh.ref_text: 欢迎来到温暖的手作工坊呀好朋友，我们一起点亮小灯笼，动手做件有趣的作品吧。
artisan_female_zh.instruct: 明快干练又温柔的年轻女达人声音，二十多岁清亮温和的青年女中音，充满活力与亲和力，面带微笑，语速从容清晰。

artisan_male_en.ref_text: Welcome to our sunny island workshop... Take a close look at the bright stars and handmade crafts.
artisan_male_en.instruct: A friendly, upbeat young male island craftsman in his late twenties. Warm, clear, approachable tenor voice with an encouraging smile, steady and unhurried pace for children.

artisan_male_zh.ref_text: 欢迎来到阳光海岛手工坊，快走近看看这些闪亮的星星和精致的小手作吧。
artisan_male_zh.instruct: 阳光爽朗的年轻男手艺人声音，二十多岁干净温暖的青年男中音，乐观亲切、面带微笑，语速平稳舒缓，吐字清晰有力。

boy_sunny_en.ref_text: Hey buddy, nice to see you at school! Let's pass the football and play on the green grass!
boy_sunny_en.instruct: A cheerful, friendly ten-year-old elementary school boy speaking happily to his classmate. Genuine youthful boy timbre, bright and sunny smile, clear and unhurried child-friendly pace without shouting.

boy_sunny_zh.ref_text: 嘿好伙伴，在学校见到你真开心！下课后我们一起去绿茵操场上踢足球吧！
boy_sunny_zh.instruct: 阳光开朗的十岁小学小男孩声音，清脆朝气的少年童声，热情友善、面带笑容，吐字清晰自然，语速适中偏舒缓，不尖锐不吵闹。

elder_wise_en.ref_text: Welcome to our quiet reading hall, young explorer... Every book holds a bright star of wisdom.
elder_wise_en.instruct: A kind, wise, grandfatherly school principal and librarian in his sixties. Gentle, resonant, scholarly older male voice, calm and patient smile, slow and soothing storytelling cadence.

elder_wise_zh.ref_text: 欢迎来到静谧书屋呀小探索家，每一本故事书里，都藏着闪闪发光的智慧呢。
elder_wise_zh.instruct: 慈祥睿智的老爷爷与老校长声音，六十岁左右温和儒雅的长辈男声，眼神慈爱、声音沉稳柔和，语速缓慢从容，充满书卷气。

father_warm_en.ref_text: Hey champ, pull up your wooden chair... Let's open this storybook and read it slowly together.
father_warm_en.instruct: A warm, patient, encouraging young father in his thirties reading with his child. Gentle baritone timbre with a friendly smile, calm and unhurried pace about fifteen percent slower than normal broadcast, clear articulation.

father_warm_zh.ref_text: 嗨宝贝，把小木椅拉过来坐好，爸爸陪你一起慢慢翻开这本有趣的故事书吧。
father_warm_zh.instruct: 温暖耐心的年轻爸爸声音，三十多岁温和男中音，带着鼓励的微笑陪孩子读书，声音醇厚亲切，语速从容放慢约百分之十五，清晰自然。

girl_bright_en.ref_text: Hi my friend, look at the colourful flowers! Let's draw a bright picture and learn English together!
girl_bright_en.instruct: A sweet, lively nine-year-old elementary school girl chatting warmly with her best friend. Clear, bright, smiling young girl voice, gentle and unhurried storybook rhythm, crisp pronunciation.

girl_bright_zh.ref_text: 嗨好朋友，快看那边五颜六色的花朵！我们一起画画、一起开心学英语吧！
girl_bright_zh.instruct: 元气甜美的九岁小学小女孩声音，清脆干净的女童音色，带着开心纯真的微笑，语速温和从容、吐字清楚好听。

grandma_warm_en.ref_text: Come into the sunny greenhouse, dear child... Look how softly the little yellow flowers are blooming.
grandma_warm_en.instruct: A loving, gentle grandmother in her sixties tending a flower garden. Soft, affectionate, comforting older female voice with a warm smile and a slow, unhurried lullaby-like storybook pace.

grandma_warm_zh.ref_text: 快进阳光花房来吧好孩子，看看这些金黄色的小花朵，开得多么温柔漂亮呀。
grandma_warm_zh.instruct: 慈爱温和的花婆婆奶奶声音，六十岁左右亲切慈祥的长辈女声，带着疼爱孩子的微笑，声音轻柔舒缓，慢条斯理、温暖人心。

mascot_dino_en.ref_text: Hello little friend, I am Dino! Let's count the shining stars and read fun words together!
mascot_dino_en.instruct: An adorable, playful baby dinosaur cartoon mascot friend for kids. Cute, rounded, bubbly childlike voice full of wonder and friendliness, soft and pleasant without harsh squeaking, unhurried pace.

mascot_dino_zh.ref_text: 嗨好朋友，我是可爱的小恐龙！我们一起数一数亮晶晶的星星，慢慢读英语吧！
mascot_dino_zh.instruct: 呆萌可爱的卡通小恐龙伙伴声音，圆润讨喜、充满好奇心的童趣萌音，柔和欢快而不刺耳，带着微笑陪小朋友慢速学说话。

mascot_parrot_en.ref_text: Hello sunny friend, what a nice hat! Follow me closely, and let's say each word with a smile!
mascot_parrot_en.instruct: A cheerful, musical little parrot mascot companion for children. Bright, bouncy, playful young cartoon voice with a happy smile, crisp syllable pronunciation and friendly unhurried rhythm.

mascot_parrot_zh.ref_text: 你好呀阳光小宝贝，你的小帽子真好看！跟着小鹦鹉一起微笑着大声读出来吧！
mascot_parrot_zh.instruct: 俏皮灵动的卡通小鹦鹉伙伴声音，清脆欢快、富有音乐节奏感的萌趣童声，甜美讨喜不尖锐，吐字格外清楚，语速温和易跟读。

mother_affectionate_en.ref_text: Welcome home, sweetie... Come sit on the soft sofa, and tell Mom about your sunny day.
mother_affectionate_en.instruct: A gentle, affectionate young mother in her early thirties speaking lovingly to her child. Warm, soft, smiling maternal voice, unhurried storybook pace about fifteen percent slower than broadcast, clear and soothing.

mother_affectionate_zh.ref_text: 欢迎回家呀宝贝，快过来坐到柔软的沙发上，跟妈妈说说今天开心的事吧。
mother_affectionate_zh.instruct: 温柔慈爱的年轻妈妈声音，三十岁左右，面带微笑地对孩子轻声说话，音色柔和温暖、充满母爱，语速比播音慢约百分之十五，吐字圆润舒缓。

storyteller_en.ref_text: Once upon a sunny morning... little Kitty curled up softly in a warm patch of golden light.
storyteller_en.instruct: An expressive, dreamy picture-book narrator sister reading a cozy fairy tale to children. Warm, lyrical, smiling young female voice with gentle breathing pauses and an unhurried, soothing storybook cadence.

storyteller_zh.ref_text: 在暖洋洋的晨光里，可爱的小猫咪蜷在柔软的垫子上，安静地听着故事呢。
storyteller_zh.instruct: 生动温柔的绘本故事姐姐声音，年轻甜美又富有画面感，像在给小朋友面对面讲童话故事，轻柔微笑，语速舒缓，停顿自然温暖。

teacher_gentle_en.ref_text: Good morning, class... Please open your English books, and let's read this warm sentence together.
teacher_gentle_en.instruct: A kind, patient elementary school female English teacher in her late twenties. Bright yet gentle smiling timbre, crystal-clear pronunciation for young learners, unhurried pace about fifteen percent slower than broadcast.

teacher_gentle_zh.ref_text: 同学们早上好呀，请翻开课桌上的英语书，跟老师一起轻轻读出这个句子吧。
teacher_gentle_zh.instruct: 亲切耐心的小学年轻女老师声音，二十八岁左右，面带微笑、温柔鼓励，普通话标准清亮而不刺耳，语速舒缓放慢约百分之十五，适合儿童跟读。

uncle_warm_en.ref_text: Good morning, little neighbour... Fresh apple cakes and warm bread are waiting right out of the oven.
uncle_warm_en.instruct: A jolly, big-hearted village baker uncle in his forties. Rich, rounded, cozy deep male voice full of warmth and hospitality, smiling kindly, relaxed and unhurried pace.

uncle_warm_zh.ref_text: 早上好呀小邻居，刚出炉的热面包和金黄苹果蛋糕，正冒着甜甜的香气呢。
uncle_warm_zh.instruct: 憨厚温暖的面包房大叔声音，四十多岁圆润醇厚的暖男低音，热情慈祥、笑呵呵地招呼小朋友，语速慢悠悠、让人倍感安心。
